name: gamifiedui-monorepo
description: Game-style 2D / 2.5D UI components for Tailwind CSS v4: pixel frames, depth, sprites, isometric and animation.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=gamifiedui-demo
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=gamifiedui-icons && npm run build --workspace=gamifiedui-css && npm run build --workspace=gamifiedui-utils && npm run build --workspace=gamifiedui-sfx
scripts.test: node scripts/check-css.mjs && npm run check --workspace=gamifiedui-icons && npm run check --workspace=gamifiedui-css && npm run check --workspace=gamifiedui-utils && npm run check --workspace=gamifiedui-sfx
